Jenna (People Ops): Quick flag — compliance refresher (mandatory) got an org-wide calendar invite for Tue 10:00–11:00 next week. I just realized Benefits Open Enrollment Q&A is Tue 10:30–11:30 and we also have some performance calibration drop-in slots on Tue afternoon. Can we avoid forcing folks to pick between them? :thinking:
Alex Chen: Ugh, thanks for catching. We pushed the compliance slot because the trainer was only available then. Any wiggle room with the trainer?
Maria (HR): Trainer only has Tue/Thu mornings this month. If we move compliance to Thu 11:00 we overlap less with the benefits Q&A. Is Thu 11 ok for most teams? :calendar:
Sam K.: Thu 11 would be fine for Eng. Heads-up: some folks already RSVP'd to the Tue compliance invite. If we move it we should auto-notify and update the attendance tracking CSV.
Jenna (People Ops): Good point. I'll update the invite and post an editable attendee list. Also want to ensure managers get visibility since performance calibration drop-ins are timeline-sensitive.
Benefits Bot: Automated reminder — Benefits Open Enrollment Q&A on Tue 10:30–11:30 remains scheduled. See docs: https://playbook.internal/benefits/enrollment-2026
Alex Chen: Can you add a brief note in the benefits Q&A that employees who need a recording should request one? Some engineers are remote in APAC.
Maria (HR): Will do. Jenna, if you move compliance to Thu 11, can you also run a quick check to see who had conflicts? I can help run the RSVP diff.
Jenna (People Ops): Yes — I'll publish a small report. Command I use to export calendar RSVPs for a week (internal):
```
calctl export --range 2026-03-30,2026-04-05 --organizer jenna@redwood.com --format csv > week_rsvps.csv
```
Sam K.: Nice. Once you have the CSV, can you also tag any people who are managers so we can ping them about calibration slots? I can provide the manager list.
Jenna (People Ops): Yep. Plan: 1) move compliance to Thu 11:00, 2) update invite and post changed time in #general, 3) export RSVP CSV and run diff vs manager list, 4) ping managers of impacted direct reports to reschedule calibration drop-ins if needed. Sound good? :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Please include a short blurb about why we moved it (trainer availability) so people don't think we arbitrarily reshuffled things.
Maria (HR): I'll update the benefits Q&A channel message to include recording availability and note the compliance date change once you confirm.
Benefits Bot: RSVP export ready: S3://redwood-ops/exports/week_rsvps_1893456789.csv (expires in 7 days).
Jenna (People Ops): Exported and diffed. Quick summary: 42 RSVPs for Tue compliance; 31 of those also RSVP'd to Benefits Q&A overlapping window. I will send calendar updates and an email summary to managers by EOD.
Sam K.: Thanks — can you also include the calibration drop-in schedule so managers can nudge team members who book conflicting slots?
Jenna (People Ops): Will do. Draft of manager email (pull request welcome):
"Hi managers — due to trainer availability, mandatory compliance training has been moved from Tue 10:00–11:00 to Thu 11:00–12:00. We observed 31 people with overlapping RSVPs for Benefits Q&A. Please review your directs' calendars and reschedule calibration drop-ins if they conflict. Recording will be available for those who cannot attend. If you have direct team members in APAC, coordinate offline for suitable times. — Jenna"
Alex Chen: LGTM. Minor nit: add link to where the recording will land (Playbook recordings folder).
Jenna (People Ops): Added link. I'll send in ~30m after updating the invites. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
